title: Hearty Umami Syrian Cabbage Gratin
description: A comforting and flavorful ovo-vegetarian Syrian dish featuring hispi sweetheart cabbage, beurre-monte, and rich umami flavors, perfect for a sick day
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until softened
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute
In a large bowl, combine the shredded cabbage, cooked onion and garlic, allspice, sumac, salt, and black pepper
In a separate saucepan, melt the beurre-monte over low heat
Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with the melted beurre-monte
Add the cabbage mixture to the prepared baking dish and top with crumbled feta cheese
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown
